notes.A: The close lettering and lamp row lead down the street, but the entrance is cropped.
notes.B: The station sign and lamps frame the approach, but the nearest lamp dominates.
notes.C: The narrow alley shows how tightly the buildings stand, but the steep angle obscures entrances.
notes.D: The recessed doorway and corner lamps show the threshold, but the tight crop loses the forecourt.
notes.E: The high angle ties the entrance to neighboring buildings, but the doorway blends into masonry.
notes.F: The full frontage anchors the forecourt, though the doorway reads as a dark slot.
notes.G: The opposite façade and lamp row define the square, but the station slips offscreen.
notes.H: The open paving and opposite façade establish scale, but the station entrance falls outside the frame.

station_front.best: F shows both signs, the recessed entrance, the row of lamps, and how the station sits across from its neighbors.
station_front.lacks: The station lacks a recognizable entrance. The green lettering carries most of its identity because the doorway disappears into the same dark stone as the surrounding walls.
station_front.fix: Add a lit iron-and-glass canopy over the station entrance, projecting above the pavement so the way in is visible from across the forecourt.

blind_name.name: Cobblestone city courtyard
blind_name.why: Glowing streetlamps light a cobblestone plaza surrounded by tall masonry buildings.
blind_name.odd: Deep shadows obscure the windows and the passage on the right.
